slides.heading: Slicing Lists
slides.body: Slicing Lists is part of List Operations and Methods. This short lesson gives you a practical Python idea you can understand, try, and reuse in simple programs.

slides.heading: Core Idea: Slicing Lists
slides.body: Slicing creates a portion of a list using start and stop indexes. The stop index is not included.

slides.heading: Real-World Analogy
slides.body: Slicing is like cutting a piece from a long ribbon without taking the whole ribbon.
